The minority level_002 group has about 578 cells and level_001 about 1422, satisfying cell-size stability. The directional hypothesis remains that level_002 corresponds to stronger dependency, though prior null makes expectation uncertain. Third, feature_034 is tested on outcome_011. H1-H3 rejected feature_034 associations for outcome_001, outcome_013, and outcome_014, but outcome_011 has a different variance profile and could still show a predictor-specific effect. Fourth, feature_064 is tested with absence versus presence on outcome_013. This uses a remaining well-powered binary feature, with about 383 absent cells and 1617 present cells. The hypothesis is that absence of feature_064 is associated with stronger dependency on outcome_013; alternatives include no association or stronger dependency in the present group.
